resources.string: Listens in your phone\'s speech language
Tap the mic and start speaking
Pick your languages, tap the mic, and your translations will appear here. Say \"stop\" or \"exit\" to end a session.
Could not understand! Please try again.
Could not reach the speech service. Check your internet connection.
Microphone permission is required to translate speech.
Speech recognition is not available on this device.
There was a problem with the microphone.
Something went wrong with speech recognition. Please try again.
Translation failed. Check your internet connection (needed once to download a language pack).
No text-to-speech voice is installed for %1$s. Install one in your phone\'s Text-to-speech settings.
LinguaSync translates your voice from one language to another in real time. Choose the input and output languages, then start speaking – you get the translated text on screen and spoken aloud.
Your speech is converted to text by Android\'s speech recognizer.
The text is translated on your device with ML Kit.
The translation is read aloud with Android text-to-speech.
Android port of the open-source Python project “real-time-voice-translator”, released under the GNU GPL v2.
